note: Declarative placeholder identifiers for Research Part 2, Phase II-A (Oracle Expert Retention). No policy is implemented here; this file only reserves stable identifiers so later experiment configs can reference them declaratively. No measured result is recorded or implied.

CURRENT_ARGINE.description: Current Argine retention/eviction behaviour as implemented in the expert store (argine/expert_store.py), unchanged.

LRU.description: Global least-recently-used eviction over the expert pool.

LFU.description: Global least-frequently-used eviction over the expert pool.

ORACLE.description: Offline Belady-style oracle (upper bound), as used for the Research Part 1 replay engine (argine/research/replay / Belady-style oracle policy family).
ORACLE.implementation_ref: argine.research replay engine already implements an offline oracle policy family (Research Part 1); R2-02 is expected to reference, not reimplement, it
